Designed by renowned architect James K.M. Cheng, The Palisades West is ideally located in Vancouver's West End, at the corner of Alberni and Bute Streets. Bright and well-maintained 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom apartment located on the 17th floor of The Palisades West. This 761 sq. ft. home features laminate flooring throughout, large windows with beautiful city views, a spacious in-suite storage room, and in-suite laundry. The kitchen is equipped with a refrigerator, stove, built-in microwave, and dishwasher. Building Amenities:*Fitness centre*Meeting room*Landscaped gardens*Children's playground*Secure underground parking*Bike storage*Elevators*Wheelchair accessibleSorry no pets/smoking.
